name: Convex MCP
description: Connects coding agents to Convex deployments over MCP to browse tables and schemas, run read-only queries and functions, read logs, and manage environment variables.

skills.name: Inspect Tables
skills.description: Lists a deployment's tables with their declared and inferred schemas, and pages through the documents in any table.

skills.name: Read-Only Queries
skills.description: Runs sandboxed read-only JavaScript queries against a deployment's data without being able to modify the database.

skills.name: Run Functions
skills.description: Executes deployed Convex functions with given arguments, and returns the type, visibility, and interface of every function.

skills.name: Logs and Insights
skills.description: Fetches recent function execution logs and 72-hour health insights on OCC conflicts and resource limit issues.

skills.name: Environment Variables
skills.description: Lists, reads, sets, and removes a Convex deployment's environment variables from the agent's MCP client.
